_about: A preview, computed in memory: the cross-state pairs the 2026-2030 DESC list would make with the Georgia filings, with the app's own overlap code (backend/gridlock.py, imported unchanged). The app still ranks the 2024-2028 list; nothing here is live. Pairs are places the utilities could coordinate, as filed, never a statement that they are or aren't coordinating.
today_note: the date the shared build windows are measured against (still ahead / open now / ended); a run on another day recomputes those counts, and --today YYYY-MM-DD reproduces this file
georgia: the Georgia projects in data/projects.json (the build's, unchanged)
